reports.title: AECOM reports fourth quarter and full year fiscal 2026 results

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Financial Guidance
section: · | AECOM initiated financial guidance for fiscal 2027 that contemplates the benefits from the Company’s record backlog and pipeline, strong end market trends, and expected margin expansion to a new all-time high:
‒ | Organic NSR2 growth of between 4% and 6%.
‒ | Both a segment adjusted1 operating margin4 and an adjusted EBITDA margin6 of 17.6%.
‒ | Adjusted1 EPS of between $6.15 and $6.35 and adjusted1 EBITDA5 of between $1,350 and $1,390 million.

‒ | Free cash flow7 of approximately $300 million, which includes a continued expectation for approximately $500 million of cash use related to the two Construction Management projects in fiscal 2027.
- | An average fully diluted share count of 130 million, which does not include any benefits from potential capital allocation actions, such as potential repurchases.
- | An adjusted1 effective tax rate of approximately 22%.
- | Adjusted1 net interest expense of approximately $170 million.
- | General and administrative expenses of approximately $160 million.
· | See the Regulation G Information tables at the end of this release for a reconciliation of non-GAAP measures to the most directly comparable GAAP measures.

desk.headline: Adjusted EPS up 20% to $1.63, beat; revenue down 7% to $3.88bn, miss; FY27 outlook initiated at $6.15–6.35 adjusted EPS
results: Revenue fell 7% to $3.88bn as the lower-margin construction management business shrank; net service revenue rose 3% after allowing for fewer working days, with design up 6%.
Adjusted EPS rose 20% to $1.63; segment margin hit a record 18.2% and adjusted EBITDA margin 19.2%. GAAP EPS was flat at $0.99.
Full-year revenue was $15.1bn (down 6%); full-year GAAP EPS fell 41% to $2.84, hit by the $337m construction management charge taken in Q3.
Record wins of $13.4bn for the year lifted backlog 13% to a record $28.0bn; the two troubled construction management projects are on budget and schedule.
Q4 free cash flow was $274m and full-year $344m, ahead of prior guidance; the quarterly dividend goes up 10% to $0.34.

guidance.summary: AECOM set its first fiscal 2027 outlook: adjusted EPS of $6.15–6.35, adjusted EBITDA of $1.35–1.39bn and 4–6% organic NSR growth, with record margins of 17.6%. Free cash flow of about $300m includes about $500m of cash use on the two construction management projects.

watch: Delivery of the second construction management project, due near the end of fiscal Q2, and the end of the related cash drain.
Whether design growth keeps accelerating and margins move toward the 17.6% target.
